Good food but need better wine
Apr 2021 • Solo
The foods were delicious, I especially like the foie gras, very nicely cooled. However a huge minus point for me is the wine selection. While they offer French, Italian and Chilean wine by glass, I don't think any of them is good enough for their price. I have had worse steak but with better wine at cheaper places in HCMC
Written May 2, 2021
DannyDzuy
Dear Lee_N_76,
Thank you for visiting The First. We are happy you loved the food, and grateful for making the trip to our new location. We appreciate your feedback on the wine list – since we had to relocate from our previous location, we had to shorten the menu to make it as compact as possible for the move. We really apologize for the wine offering in this short transitioning period. HOWEVER, we have completed our re-selection of wine and will have a completely new wine list (5 by glass and 20 by bottles, including Italian, French, Chilean, New Zealand,...) and will renew this list every 3-4 months to pair with our seasonal food menu. We appreciate you taking the time for the review, and hope to see you at The First again soon!

Unreal
Jun 2020 • Couples
As someone else wrote, this really is a hidden gem. 

We have been in Vietnam for 3 months now and have struggled to find restaurants with the ‘wow factor’, I am so glad we came here, left feeling happy and very satisfied. 

It is more expensive than a bowl of pho on the street, but it’s worth every penny. The quality of the meat is definitely up there with Gaucho and Hawksmoor. 

The restaurant itself is also very nice, very sleek place, that just screams of good taste. 

I recommend you try the lamb, OMG it was unreal.

I had a dinner here and i was partly disappointed
Dec 2019 • Friends
I had a dinner here and the food was really good. The staff was nice also. I have one IMPORTANT thing to mention. We ordered starters and main course. So i choose a steak with SIDE dish which was potato wedges. So before any other food the potato wedges show up on our table and we mentioned to the staff we ordered potato wedges with the steak. So they take the plate away then 5 mins later they bring back the same dish saying i ordered this. So i said yes i did but WITH THE STEAK. We do not even get our starters yet. So on the end they push me to take the potato and i get the steak around 25 minutes later when the potato was obviously cold. All in all i had a good time here, but a professional place would take the wedges and bring a fresh one with the steak. Massive difference between starter and side dish. And the potato as side dish was together on the menu with the steak. Weird....

DannyDzuy
Dear ViktorW188,

Thank you for coming to The First. We are glad that you loved the food. At the moment, we have a few trainees in the house in preparation for the busy season at the end of the year. Our waiter trainee must have mistaken the potato wedge appetizer for the potato side dish. We sincerely apologize for the mistake during your visit, and will make sure this will not happen again. We hope you give us another shot and come back another time.

Such a bad experience
Dec 2019 • Couples
We order the aus beef for the steak and finally they charged us the us beef so totally bill is double as what we ordered. The owner said like we have to pay for what we just ate. WTF service is!
Review collected in partnership with this restaurant 
Written December 27, 2019
DannyDzuy
This customer and his company came and ordered 2 portions of USDA Prime Ribeye and 2 glasses of wine. We served them exactly what they ordered as we already repeated the order twice. After they finished EVERYTHING without any complaint during their meal (we checked several times during their meal and they said the food was fine), they asked for the bill. Then they suddenly became very rude and refused to pay as they insisted they ordered the Australian grass-fed Ribeye, which is one third of the price of the USDA Prime. We still have footage of the entire meal, and evidence of their rudeness. The two caused a "scene" that was so obscene and affected other eaters, we had to politely asked them to pay. On top of that, they even went on other social media and food review sites to make up stories and rated us badly. Restaurant owners, please beware of these two customers and their lies to get freebies.

Surprisingly good steak!
Dec 2019
My boyfriend surprised with a birthday dinner here and I was skeptical at first. I’ve been to dozens of steakhouses in Saigon and thought I couldn’t be impressed anymore. Boy how wrong was I? At a price that’s a third of other ‘fancy’ steakhouses like El Gaucho, you get the same quality beef. The flavor of the steak and the food here are generally bold. Our waiter even explained to us they use Phu Quoc pepper which is the best pepper in Vietnam. Service was great, attentive and friendly. We enjoyed everything and definitely recommend The First!

Cheating with the sizes
Sep 2019 • Couples
First night in town. We were recommended to try this restaurant since they had meat and beer (I like meat and beer).

We ordered lamb racks, the good was tasty but according to the menu it should have been 350 grams, it was rather 180 grams, three small pieces of lamb with one small potato and three small asparagus.

We pointed this out to the waitress but she shrugged her shoulders and said it was so they learned how to weigh meat, each slice is 120 grams (!?)

It was good but definitely not worth the price for the small portion we got!

Now we have to go and eat something more to get satisfied.
Read more
Review collected in partnership with this restaurant 
Written September 5, 2019
DannyDzuy
Dear Mikate75,

First of all, we apologize for not meeting your expectation during your visit to The First. Your review came as a surprise to us though, since our restaurant has never received complaints on the portion of the dishes. In fact, we had a lot of feedback for offering dishes with bigger portion than expected! Our rack of lamb is French-cut, meaning, we trim off all the fat and leave the bone in with the lean meat. We weigh our meat carefully to make sure each dish has the right portion. Each rack of lamb comes with potatoes and sauteed vegetables also. In addition, we offer three different sizes for our lamb: 350gr, 500gr and 1kg. Once again, we apologize that you didn't feel completely satisfied with our offering, and hope you understand we never cut corners. We hope you do come back to try many other dishes in our broad menu to see our generous portioning, and of course, quality of the dishes.
